title: Beanbag Balance Battle
description: Balance a beanbag on the bas while walking through a safe space and changing direction.
target: Complete 5 one-minute rounds without dropping it

title: Cone Lift Challenge
description: Use the butt of the hurley to lift a cone and carry it back to a target area.

title: Keep It Moving
description: Strike the sliotar along the ground and try to keep it moving between two safe markers.

title: Colour Gate Dribble
description: Set up coloured gates and dribble through the colour called by a helper.
